pr.body: Implemented in retry_budget.py using only the standard library. Added validation and edge-case coverage in test_retry_budget.py. Verification: python -m unittest -v (11 passed); git diff --check (passed). Independent review passed with no findings. No known limitations.
pr.summary: Implemented spec-compliant bounded retry delay scheduling with argument validation, capped exponential backoff, Retry-After floors, and strict budget checks. Before: retry_delay was unimplemented; now callers receive validated delay decisions. Added focused boundary tests.
pr.title: Implement bounded retry delay scheduling

risk.why: Pure integer-only retry scheduling with bounded scope; validation, attempt exhaustion, saturating backoff, Retry-After floor, and strict budget boundary match SPEC.md. All 11 unit tests pass.

Contained pure integer scheduling behavior in retry_budget.py with focused tests in test_retry_budget.py; no persistence, concurrency, or external interfaces beyond the requested function. All 11 tests and whitespace checks pass; independent reviewer found no issues.
